game.plainAsk: Reserved matters for plot P01: 247 homes on the Convoys Wharf outline. The site-wide floor is 15% affordable by habitable room.
game.plainImpact: Do not read this as 20% or 35%. The 2015 S106 set a 15% site-wide floor. Housing Delivery Test 2025: 65%. That is not the weakest in London — Greenwich is 42%. Lewisham has 2,317 households in temporary accommodation (31 March 2026).
